hook: Lot 3A of the Dircks subdivision of 1892, where a shipwright's house was moved in 1893.

historic_survey.note: Not inventoried on a record of its own; the lot is traced in the report's district record for the boat yards next door. The report's narrative also places a building of Anderson's yard, an engine shop with a hoist and storage, at "904½ Innes Avenue" on the 1913–15 Sanborn map.

historical_record.description: A dwelling was moved onto this lot from across the bay and occupied as the Jorgenson house at 904 9th Avenue.
Johnson J. Dircks subdivided the corner lot at 9th (Innes) Avenue and G (Griffith) Street and sold this half and the one next door to the boat builder Charles J. Jorgenson.
